SEARCH
Package neqsim.thermo.characterization

Class RefineryHydrocrackingHydrogenSupplyBalance

java.lang.Object
neqsim.thermo.characterization.RefineryHydrocrackingHydrogenSupplyBalance
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public final class RefineryHydrocrackingHydrogenSupplyBalance extends Object implements Serializable
Immutable hydrogen-supply receipt coupling recovered reformer hydrogen to hydrocracking demand.

Recovered catalytic-reformer hydrogen is allocated against a qualified hydrocracking demand. Any deficit is reported as imported hydrogen and any unused recovered hydrogen as surplus. The calculation is a mass allocation, not a hydrogen-network, purity, compression, or pressure model.

Version:
1.0
